subject: prd/maintenance-sweep
statement: The sweep shall produce a byte-identical machine face and identical exit codes for identical repository state and configuration; volatile wall-clock fields (duration) carry on the human face only, never the machine face.
rationale: findings feed dispositions and diffs; nondeterminism kills trust
fit_criterion: two consecutive runs on a pinned fixture produce byte-identical machine-face output, and the machine face contains no wall-clock field
